author: reek
body: GPU kernels for globe rendering. One thread per pixel. Camera params passed as fixed-point integers (x1000). Texture as byte array. Framebuffer as 32-bit ARGB integers.

author: reek
body: real-sqrt, real-abs, real-min and real-max come from Gpu chapter DeviceMath, which has correct portable bodies; the WGSL and PTX plugs replace the calls with hardware instructions on the GPU. cordic-sin and cordic-cos are the names the emitters intercept for the hardware sine and cosine; their bodies delegate to DeviceMath so a CPU compile computes the right answer too. Nothing here lies.
